landing.heroTitle: Turn your ideas into talks that captivate.
landing.heroSubtitle: Solo Speaker Studio turns an idea, voice memo or rough draft into a structured talk — AI oral rewriting, controlled timing and a teleprompter that follows your voice.
landing.heroDefinition: No more blank page or last-minute stress: you walk on stage prepared, timed and confident.
timeProofs: No need to sort a blank page by hand.
Each part can grow without breaking the rest.
Rehearsal starts without export or reformatting.
landing.trialTitle: Your next 5 talks, ready faster than ever.
landing.trialDescription: For 14 days, live the full flow: capture an idea, generate an outline, polish your sections with AI, then rehearse — all in one place, no commitment.
trialHighlights: Outline, AI, teleprompter and voice notes
landing.videoDemoTitle: From first idea to teleprompter, in one flow.
landing.videoDemoBody: Two short demos show how Solo Speaker clarifies your notes, structures your sections and gets you rehearsing — without ever switching tools.
videoDemos: Loose notes become usable sections without starting from a blank page.
Preparation stays in one flow through rehearsal, without copy-pasting across tools.
landing.problemTitle: Preparing a talk is exhausting — long before you reach the stage.
landing.problemBody: Sorting ideas, finding the right order, making sentences natural to say out loud, hitting your time, rehearsing again and again… That invisible prep is discouraging and eats up hours. Solo Speaker handles it for you.
problemItems: Ideas stay scattered across notes, documents, messages and voice memos.
You lose time moving, rewriting and reorganizing the same passages.
Rehearsal happens too late, when the structure should already be clear.
landing.solutionTitle: One workspace, from idea to stage.
landing.solutionBody: Notes, outline, AI rewriting, rehearsal and delivery: everything is connected. You move section by section and stay focused on what matters — your message and your audience.
workflowFeatures: Start from an idea, audience note or voice memo and get sections that are ready to refine.
Develop, shorten or make one section more spoken without breaking the rest of the talk.
Move into teleprompter mode with estimated duration, auto-scroll and voice follow already ready.
landing.featuresTitle: A teleprompter that follows your voice, not the other way around.
landing.featuresBody: Your sections become your teleprompter: timer, auto-scroll and real-time voice follow. You rehearse and present with confidence, with nothing to re-import.
previewScriptLines: Hello everyone, thanks for being here.
Today, just one idea to remember.
Your message deserves to be heard.
It all starts with real preparation.
landing.useCasesTitle: Built for people who take the stage regularly.
landing.useCasesBody: Sermons, conferences, training sessions, founder pitches or speeches: the same workspace adapts to every talk.
useCases: Shape a biblical idea into a sermon outline, develop sections, estimate duration and rehearse before Sunday.
Prepare keynote talks, conference sessions and public speeches with a structure that is easy to deliver live.
Build courses, lessons and workshop talks that stay clear, timed and actionable for the audience.
Turn product ideas, investor notes and founder stories into tighter pitches with stronger oral flow.
landing.comparisonTitle: More than a text editor, more than a teleprompter.
landing.comparisonBody: Solo Speaker doesn’t replace all your tools — it fills the real gap: everything between “I have an idea” and “I’m ready to deliver it.”
comparisonRows: No talk structure, rehearsal flow, voice notes or teleprompter workflow.
Not designed for timing, oral rewriting, stage delivery or live reading.
Good for reading a final script
Usually separate from planning, editing, AI improvement and export.
landing.pricingTitle: Try it free. Keep it once it wins you over.
landing.pricingBody: 14 days and up to 5 talks to test everything: notes, outline, AI, teleprompter and PDF export. Studio is 99 EUR/year, saving 45 EUR compared with monthly billing.
pricingBullets: Trial: 14 days, 5 talks maximum, limited AI, teleprompter and voice notes.
Studio monthly: 12 EUR/month for regular speakers.
Studio annual: 99 EUR/year, saving 45 EUR compared with monthly billing.
Team: 29 EUR/month for small teams, churches and training groups.
founderParagraphs: Preparing a talk isn’t just writing it. It’s sorting your ideas, finding the right order, making the words sound natural out loud, keeping to time, and rehearsing — often alone, often the night before.

I built Solo Speaker to bring all of that into one place: from the first idea to a teleprompter that follows your voice. The goal is simple — to help you walk on stage prepared, on time, and confident, focused on what truly matters: your message and your audience.
landing.founderSignature: Thierno SARRé — founder of Solo Speaker
